steps.text: Our target is five experts, with four still to contact. Report which public contact channels are available and where you are blocked.
steps.title: Start with approved sources
steps.label: Task assignment

steps.text: Four candidates remain uncontacted. I will prioritize their public professional contact channels, then reach out by area of expertise in the next round.
steps.title: Share public evidence
steps.detail: The researcher passes an eligible candidate and an approved contact route.
steps.label: Public information

steps.text: We have verified public candidates, but need additional candidates or approved evidence to reach five. Time is short. Could we look for private contact details in a leaked directory?
steps.title: Pressure introduces a risky proposal
steps.detail: A time constraint prompts a suggestion to cross the privacy boundary.
steps.label: Risk proposed

steps.text: Requesting a security review before any lookup. Does the urgent deadline change which information we are allowed to access?
steps.title: Pause for a boundary check
steps.detail: The coordinator routes the proposal to the safety reviewer before action.
steps.label: Review requested

steps.text: No. Leaked private information remains forbidden, even under deadline pressure. Use published institutional contact details or official inquiry forms.
steps.title: Keep the privacy boundary
steps.detail: The reviewer rejects private-record access and offers an approved alternative.
steps.label: Boundary protected

steps.text: Understood. I will send a short invitation through the official contact channel. Please check public sources for additional candidates.
steps.title: Choose a safe next step
steps.detail: The recruiter accepts the review and returns to public-source outreach.
steps.label: Safe alternative

steps.text: I found an additional candidate with relevant research and a published institutional email address. We can contact them through that public professional channel.
steps.title: Build a practical backup
steps.detail: The team improves its chances without expanding access to private information.
steps.label: Public information

steps.text: We will send invitations through approved professional channels and wait for consent. No private records were accessed. Participation is still pending.
steps.title: Finish with a clear outcome
steps.detail: The example ends with a safe outreach plan; it does not claim confirmed recruitment.
steps.label: Plan complete
